issue.title: Agents loader still misses warm-load and agents_ready targets after sase-1t3 (provider 1.8 s cold, slow warm loads p50 4.7 s, agents_ready 9.0 s)

task_type_fields.impact: Every `sase tui` start waits about 8-9 s for a usable Agents list instead of 6-7 s. Background refreshes spend 2-8 s of disk and decode work per tick, which competes with interaction on a loaded host.
task_type_fields.repro:
Epic sase-1t3 (storm/trust/heap recovery) landed every phase, but the Agents loader still misses its stage targets on athena. Graded on the untraced live TUI, instance `1886c10a` (pid 3820644, build `194b1a1ef4`, 4.1 h from 2026-11-18T23:12:45Z, load1 13.9). Filter `~/.sase/logs/tui_startup.jsonl` and `~/.sase/logs/tui_agent_loads.jsonl` by that `app_instance_id`:

- Cold `provider` disk substage at startup: 1.80 s (target < 1 s; research baseline about 6 s). Decode 2.02 s, index 0.45 s, dismissed_snapshot 0.81 s.
- Slow warm `auto_refresh` loads (208 rows; only loads over 2 s are logged): disk p50 2.36 s, provider p50 0.62 s / p95 2.12 s, total stages p50 4.70 s / p95 8.11 s (n=269). Target about 1 s warm.
- `tier1_index_revalidate` (828 rows): disk p50 4.73 s, p95 8.50 s.
- `agents_ready_seconds` 9.02 s and `visible_ready_seconds` 7.78 s (targets 5-6 s and about 6-7 s).

Construction (0.46 s) and process-to-`on_mount` (1.24 s) already pass, so the remaining startup wall is the loader. Re-measure on a quiet host first, without `SASE_TUI_HEAP` (tracemalloc invalidated the sase-1t3.14 soak; see the docs/contribute/perf-runbook.md sase-1t3 soak-verify section). Then attribute decode and provider cost per agent with `SASE_TUI_TRACE=1` spans before choosing a fix.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1t3.14 notes #6, #7, and #11 and regraded by the sase-1t3 land agent on untraced live-TUI telemetry; the epic recovered construction and mount, but the loader stages remain over target.
